VGK.head: Vegas has a lot going for it
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Los Angeles’s way back in is keeping the shots to the outside.

LAK.head: Los Angeles faces a real test
LAK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Los Angeles can pull it off if it keeps the shots to the outside.
